LibTmux.Query.Link

Description

Fields and navigation for an observed sessionindexwindow binding.

Use with LibTmux.Query. All tokens belong to the tmux 3.3a baseline. The same physical window can occur at several indices in one session; WindowLink retains each appearance. active is contextual to the session.
